name: Hispaniolan green anole
desc: A tree-dwelling lizard that hunts insects such as ants on trunks and foliage.
about: Anolis chlorocyanus, the Tiburon green anole or Hispaniolan green anole or Jeremie anole, is a species of anole endemic to Haiti, primarily the Tiburon Peninsula and Jérémie and Hispaniola.
